patch_description: Add a small, demand-dependent cost to links that appear unusually often in the selected two-hop route rewards. Such links can attract many routes in the surrogate and become bottlenecks; this local adjustment nudges both sampling and energy-based ranking toward alternatives. The penalty is capped relative to the existing mean direct-link score and applies only to the most frequently coupled active links. It does not change or duplicate the evaluator’s degree penalty.
